faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using Doctorly.
faq.a1: Once you book an appointment, you'll receive a secure video link. At the scheduled time, simply click the link to join the consultation with your doctor. You can use your smartphone, tablet, or computer.
faq.q2: Can I choose a specific doctor?
faq.a2: Yes, you can browse through our list of verified specialists, view their profiles, experience, and patient ratings before booking a consultation with the doctor of your choice.
faq.q3: Can I book appointments in advance?
faq.a3: Absolutely. You can schedule appointments days or weeks in advance based on the doctor's availability shown on their profile calendar.
faq.q4: Can I receive a digital prescription?
faq.a4: Yes. After your consultation, the doctor will generate a digital prescription which will be immediately available in your secure medical records section to view or download.
faq.a5: We take privacy very seriously. Doctorly is fully compliant with healthcare data protection standards. All your medical records, chat history, and personal details are encrypted and securely stored.
faq.a6: Yes, Doctorly provides a dedicated dashboard for healthcare providers to easily manage their availability, appointments, patient records, and earnings.
